caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about flat, predictable asphalt. It is about finding these hidden corridors—old access roads and forgotten paths carved into the green hillsides where the terrain demands your full attention. I design our routes to take you deep into these living landscapes, far from the tourist corridors, where every climb rewards you with a new perspective. Mountain biking expeditions with My Adventure Costa Rica, designed slowly.
